mass_player_id.label: Connected Music Assistant Player
mass_player_id.description: The Music Assistant player connected to this Spotify Connect plugin. When you start playback in the Spotify app to this virtual speaker, the audio will play on the selected player. Set to 'Auto' to automatically select a currently playing player, or the first available player if none is playing.

publish_name.label: Name to display in the Spotify app
publish_name.description: How should this Spotify Connect device be named in the Spotify app?

manifest.description: Makes a Music Assistant player appear as a device in the official Spotify app via Spotify Connect.
